title: Tribute
paragraphs: “Then, while the heroes go to Faubrey for an audience, Lady Éclair and I will prepare for the village’s reconstruction. As for the audience, my mother plans to accompany you, so you’ll need to return to the castle first.”
“All we have to do is meet the king of Faubrey, right?”
“Yes. If the heroes speak directly to King Faubrey about what you aim to achieve, he should understand. Of course, I expect he will assign some tasks, though…”
“Last time, we were relatively free to act. He’s not someone who restricts us too much.”

In the previous loop, the missions King Faubrey assigned were nothing more than asking us to confront the waves. The only other thing was delivering pigs, but if we offer Takt’s followers this time, that should take care of the issue.
“Then, we’ll go see that pig king… and by midnight, we can probably take care of Faubrey’s troubles. After that, wouldn’t it be fine to return here?”
I checked the sun to estimate the time.
Isn’t it about time for him to be awake?
“Pig king!? Huh? You mean the king of Faubrey, right?”
“…Calling him a pig is…”

Hmm? Fiancée averted her gaze and mumbled softly. Father and the others swallowed hard for some reason. Ah, right, Takt… I haven’t forgotten the grudge for what you did to Sakura-chan last time. I’ll definitely make you taste hell again.
“I have a bad feeling about this. I’d rather stay behind with Raphtalia and Sadina…”
“No can do. Ren and Itsuki happen to be the pig king’s type.”
“We’re staying behind! We’re absolutely not going!”
“Yeah! I don’t want to go!”
Tch! Ren and Itsuki are throwing a tantrum.
What’s bothering them so much!?
“But if we don’t go, the situation will gradually get worse. Look, Ren and Itsuki, as long as you clearly refuse, there won’t be any problems. At least, last time, both of you were fine.”
“What kind of explanation is that?”
Father said, scratching his hair in exasperation.
“Ugh… I feel like I’m being dragged around by a bunch of weirdos since I came to this world.”
“It’s mentally exhausting in many ways.”
“I thought this would be a dreamlike other world, but ever since we were summoned, nothing good has happened.”
“…This world is rotten. I almost wish it were more like a game.”
“Well, well… then, Raphtalia-chan and the others can stay here, and tomorrow morning, we’ll go check on the village.”
“Yes.”
“Oh my.”
Big sister’s big sister spoke cheerfully as she hugged big sister from behind.
“Big sister’s big sister. I suggest you spend tonight drinking with Father and getting along. That way, I’m sure you’ll be able to trust us.”
“Oh? I already trust you, though?”

With a lighthearted tone, big sister’s big sister spoke while hugging big sister. Father looked a little troubled as he glanced at big sister’s big sister. I later heard that she wasn’t completely convinced after all.
“Okay, we’ll take care of things quickly and be back soon.”
“Um…”
At that moment, big sister’s friend raised her hand.
“I want to go with you.”
“It’s not such an important errand.”
“That’s what they’re saying, Rifana-chan.”
“Even so… is it not okay to come along?”
Big sister’s friend seems quite curious.
“Eh…”
Big sister then took her friend’s hand.
“Hmm… Rifana-chan.”
“Yes? What is it, Naofumi-sama?”
“I’m worried about Raphtalia-chan too, so could you stay with Sadina-san and watch over her?”
Big sister’s friend looked at big sister.
“Alright… but Naofumi-sama, please don’t do anything reckless.”
“I know. I’m counting on you, Rifana-chan.”
“Leave it to me.”
Big sister’s friend waved her hand while holding big sister’s hand. Father responded with the expression of a caring guardian.
“Alright, let’s head out then. Motoyasu-kun, let’s finish this quickly and get it over with!”
“Of course!”

And so, we went to meet the queen of Melromarc and quickly proceeded to Faubrey. As expected, we arrived while the pig king was awake, and we secured permission and proof for the audience using the queen’s influence. After that, we took care of Takt and his followers, much like before. Ah, the only difference this time is that there was no bad blood between Father and Fiancée. After offering Takt’s followers to the pig king, we returned, and by then, it was already quite late at night.
“That thing was way worse than I imagined!”
“Yeah! What was that monster?! It was totally like an endgame boss from an old video game!”
“It’s even sadder to think that thing was on our side.”
When we returned to Melromarc, Ren and Itsuki protested to me, and Father responded with a look of exasperation. It’s almost the same reaction as last time.
“Thank you, Heroes, for coming to Faubrey and expressing your intentions.”
“No, thank you for arranging the audience.”
“So, all we have to do now is periodically visit Faubrey and challenge the waves in various regions, right?”
“Yes, that’s correct.”
“We’ll need to get a portal from Motoyasu-kun so everyone can move around freely.”
“Ah… but that Takt guy was weak despite being around level 340.”
“Well, it’s not that only Motoyasu-san is extraordinary. If we hadn’t listened to his warnings, we would’ve been easily lured into that evening party.”
“Yeah… when Motoyasu-kun suddenly said, ‘I see through all your schemes! I know you’re hiding two of the seven star weapons!’ and then confiscated them, I was really surprised.”

There’s no need to hold back when it comes to Takt. When we manipulated the pig king and trapped him in the harem, we struck first and took his weapons away. There’s no point in negotiations. The fact that he attacked once he realized he was cornered is proof enough. To top it off, he said something he didn’t last time.
“I’m going to become the world’s one and only strongest hero!”
The way he shouted that had me laughing. The strongest is Father. No arguments are accepted.
“We seem to have gained some leverage over their diplomacy too, and with Faubrey’s internal conflicts, we got permission to move around freely.”
“Really… it’s hard to deny that Motoyasu-san is looping at this point.”
“With this level of accuracy, there’s no room for doubt. But… sometimes I do wonder—why Motoyasu, of all people?”
“I can’t say I don’t get that… but he’s helping us out a lot, so isn’t that fine for now?”
“Well… yeah, I suppose.”
“Exactly. I won’t deny that. He’s making sure we don’t make any huge mistakes.”

And with that, the issue with Faubrey and Takt was resolved. Takt’s dragon has already been dealt with. I made sure to personally extract and securely store the large core stone. It’s filthy, but if it were to regenerate, it would be troublesome.
“Alright then… I’m worried about Raphtalia-chan, so let’s go see her.”
“Understood!”
With that, we parted ways with the queen and headed to the estate where big sister and the others were staying.
“Though… I’m really sleepy.”
“You can sleep soon. Just a little more to endure.”

Father encouraged the drowsy Ren and Itsuki. By the way, Yuki-chan and the others didn’t complain but they’re with us. When we took down Takt’s dragon, all the filolials were ecstatic. Last time, since it was already late at night, we had them sleep first. Ah, Sakura-chan stepped forward with her usual calm demeanor, as if to protect Father. Kuro-chan was shouting “Dragon Slayer!” with excitement when I finished off Takt’s dragon. Yuki-chan praised me with pride, and Kou growled with hostility toward the dragon. Well, after the victory, it’s all a wonderful memory.
“But the castle was much bigger compared to Melromarc.”
“The specialty shops in the castle town even deal in firearms. Itsuki was only using firearms later on.”
“We put that aside because of the situation, but we should probably go copy them later. We’ve set the portal, so we can go anytime.”
“Agreed.”
While talking about what happened in Faubrey and discussing our future plans, we arrived at the mansion where big sister and the others were staying.
